title: Advancing a computation state
statement: For natural numbers $C,e$, a Boolean parameter $b$, an element $c$ of the four-element set, and a natural number $i$, define a computation state as follows. If $i$ is less than the stride determined by $b$, the state is the scan-increment state with parameters $b,c,i$; otherwise it is selected from the four-entry list consisting of the second state with false, the second state with true, the scan state, and the copy state at stage $4$ when $b$ is true and stage $0$ when $b$ is false, with false bump flag, using $c$ as the index.
hypotheses_covered: choice c in a four-element set
